# kanban fixtures

- `docs-board.mmd`: the Mermaid documentation's kanban example
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/kanban.html), MIT licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist.
- `minimal.mmd`: the smallest example from the same page.
- `mermaid-svg-sample.mmd`: copied from `crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/kanban.mmd`,
  a mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples), MIT licensed.
- `cjk.mmd` is written for this crate.
